description: This file exports various functions, types, and constants, primarily re-exporting modules from the openclaw/plugin-sdk directory and some local project-specific modules. It serves as an aggregator or index file for runtime API functions related to openclaw's plugin SDK and some local runtime configurations.

methods.name: resolveIdentityNamePrefix
methods.description: Function imported from openclaw/plugin-sdk/agent-runtime that resolves identity name prefixes.

methods.name: formatInboundEnvelope
methods.description: Function to format inbound envelopes, imported from channel-inbound.

methods.name: resolveInboundSessionEnvelopeContext
methods.description: Resolves context for inbound session envelopes from channel-inbound.

methods.name: toLocationContext
methods.description: Converts data to a location context, imported from channel-inbound.

methods.name: createChannelReplyPipeline
methods.description: Creates a reply pipeline for channels, imported from channel-reply-pipeline.

methods.name: shouldComputeCommandAuthorized
methods.description: Determines if command authorization should be computed, imported from command-detection.

methods.name: recordSessionMetaFromInbound
methods.description: Records session metadata from inbound messages, imported from config.runtime.js.

methods.name: resolveChannelContextVisibilityMode
methods.description: Resolves visibility mode for channel context, imported from config.runtime.js.

methods.name: getAgentScopedMediaLocalRoots
methods.description: Retrieves media local roots scoped to the agent, from media-runtime.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Type of the loadConfig function from config.runtime.js.

methods.name: buildHistoryContextFromEntries
methods.description: Builds history context from entries, imported from reply-history.

methods.name: resolveSendableOutboundReplyParts
methods.description: Resolves parts of outbound replies that can be sent, from reply-payload.

methods.name: dispatchReplyWithBufferedBlockDispatcher
methods.description: Dispatches a reply utilizing a buffered block dispatcher, from reply-runtime.

methods.name: finalizeInboundContext
methods.description: Finalizes the context for inbound messages, from reply-runtime.

methods.name: resolveChunkMode
methods.description: Resolves mode for handling chunks, from reply-runtime.

methods.name: resolveTextChunkLimit
methods.description: Resolves text chunk limit, from reply-runtime.

methods.name: getReplyFromConfig
methods.description: Gets reply configuration, from reply-runtime.

methods.name: ReplyPayload
methods.description: Type representing reply payloads, from reply-runtime.

methods.name: resolveInboundLastRouteSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves the last route session key for inbound messages, from routing.

methods.name: resolveAgentRoute
methods.description: Resolves routing info for an agent, from routing.

methods.name: logVerbose
methods.description: Logs verbose messages, from runtime-env.

methods.name: shouldLogVerbose
methods.description: Determines if verbose logging is enabled, from runtime-env.

methods.name: getChildLogger
methods.description: Retrieves a child logger instance, from runtime-env.

methods.name: readStoreAllowFromForDmPolicy
methods.description: Reads store to allow 'from' policies for DMs, from security-runtime.

methods.name: resolveDmGroupAccessWithCommandGate
methods.description: Resolves group access for DMs with command gating, from security-runtime.

methods.name: resolvePinnedMainDmOwnerFromAllowlist
methods.description: Resolves the owner of pinned main DMs from an allowlist, from security-runtime.

methods.name: resolveMarkdownTableMode
methods.description: Resolves how markdown tables are handled, from markdown-table-runtime.

methods.name: jidToE164
methods.description: Converts JID to E164 format, from text-runtime.

methods.name: normalizeE164
methods.description: Normalizes E164 phone numbers, from text-runtime.
